intent_summary: Prepare observations in UTC chronological order, enforce calendar and event identity contracts, and expose cutoff and cadence decisions to callers.

criteria.criterion: Calendar datasets provide timestamps and frequency; positional datasets provide neither. Explicit schema-1.1 event-index sources retain timestamps without a calendar frequency.
Local timestamps require a timezone, and ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving times require an explicit offset.

Calendar duplicate timestamps require an aggregation policy; identified event-index calls can share original timestamps while duplicate logical IDs are rejected and arbitrary tie order supplies no sequence evidence.
An as_of cutoff excludes later observations, and cadence is checked as a fixed elapsed duration.

verification_evidence: Manual runtime check confirmed sorting, aggregation and cutoff transformations, the UTC window, and preserved resolved context.
Manual runtime checks confirmed null propagation for sum/mean aggregation, rejection of a 23-hour DST interval as regular daily cadence, and acceptance of explicit offsets.
